_readme: Daily course status: the one file in here that needs a human every day. Change 'updatedAt' in the same edit as the conditions — the app greys the panel out once it is older than 'staleHours', and a panel with no date at all says so and asks not to be relied on.
_live: club.json -> features.status stays false until a named person has committed to updating this daily. Fill the fields in, set that flag true, and the card appears on the Today tab. An unset field renders as a dash rather than as a guess: 'open' left null reads '—', not 'Closed'.
